newsitem.title: INDIA: Eighteen die in Kashmir as truck falls into gorge.
newsitem.headline: Eighteen die in Kashmir as truck falls into gorge.

text.p: At least 18 people died and 26 were injured, six of them seriously, in India's northern state of Jammu and Kashmir when a truck carrying passengers skidded off a road into a deep gorge, police said on Friday.
They said the accident in the 150-metre (160-yard) gorge took place near Rajouri, a town 350 km (218 miles) south of Srinagar, summer capital of the state, on Thursday night.
